current.service_desc: The Persona Platform is a cloud-native comprehensive identity verification platform hosted on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) that helps federal agencies verify users' identities. Key capabilities include: Identity verification (government ID, selfie with liveness, database and NFC verification), Fraud prevention (device and passive signals including IP, geolocation, fingerprinting to detect spoofing and deepfakes), Compliance (supports KYC, KYB, and AML workflows), and Customizable workflows (drag-and-drop journey builder and rules).

fedramp_msg.value:
This Cloud Service Offering achieved a FedRAMP 20x Class C Pilot Certification. To maintain its Marketplace listing and have its “pilot” status removed, the offering must follow the Consolidated Rules for 2026 and implement all required rules by March 7, 2027.

Note: Service offerings may have their “pilot” status removed before March 7, 2027 if they demonstrate adoption of, and adherence to, all required rules before the deadline.

timeline.to: This Cloud Service Provider is participating in the FedRAMP 20x - Phase One Pilot as a low impact Authorization. Upon completion of FedRAMP review, the offering will receive a 12 month FedRAMP Low program authorization and will be prioritized for FedRAMP Moderate program authorization in Phase Two. Agencies interested in using this service can request access directly to the CSPs materials through their own trusted repository.
